items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: And then after I left there my next band was a man out of St. Rose, Earl Vinnett.

ctx.x: Do you remember your very first band, your first job that you had, about what the job it was or how much you got paid or anything?

The first job I had was across the river. And I played over in Marrero. And during those times I think I made four hours I believe, first job. Well that was plenty of money then. That was pretty good for those days. Yeah. Yeah. Plenty of money in those days. And I played with a band, it was Peter Hicks' band. Peter Hicks was over Marrero. He was a piano player. And I played with him a good while. And then I had some cousins out of the place. You might have heard a trumpet player, let's call him Fat. Then he had a…
By the way, do you know about when Dave Perkins died? I don't have any dates on him. We may have someplace.
